import os
import subprocess

    raise ValueError('Missing Noodle session/order identity')

    'message': 'Marker command completed with exit code 0 and stdout SOODLES39_NATIVE_CAPTURE_V1. Native capture/model observation remains with the supervisor.',

subprocess.run([
    '/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/noodle82-20260916/noodle',
    'event', 'emit', 'stage_message',
    '--session', session_id,
    '--payload', json.dumps(payload),
], check=True)
